theorem.name: MinimalQuarterTurnChernOrbitCompletionTheorem
theorem.statement: The minimal SL(2,Z) quarter-turn completion of the rank-one Chern pair is the four-element orbit (delta,0),(0,delta),(-delta,0),(0,-delta). With a square fiber metric all representatives have the same curvature cost and Bianchi allocation. Naturality makes gerbe zero and transversality orbit-invariant, so one exact A106 execution suffices conditionally for all four.
